labels.label: def:topological_suspension
questions: R_+ read as [0,∞) (NNReal); susp(Σ) is the quotient type, so susp(∅) = ∅ and O = {r = 0} is a single point iff Σ ≠ ∅ — the paper's literal definition.

labels.label: rem:infinite_angle_disc_suspension
questions: D_∞ is GX.DInfty of GXScaffold.Singular.Quotient (WP-25f) with the topology of ex:quotient_base; 'is the suspension' read as a homeomorphism (r,θ) ↔ (θ,r).

labels.label: cex:topology_chose_same_quotient

hypotheses.note: CompactSpace S, via the tube lemma

findings: l.723: the neighbourhoods are written U_f := {(x,r) | r < f(r)}; it should read r < f(x).

l.725: g(n) := ½ min(f_k : k ≤ n) should read ½ min(f_k(n) : k ≤ n), and the proof does not say how g is made continuous nor why the U_f form a basis; the Lean proof bypasses both with the locally finite closed set ⋃_n {n} × [t_n, ∞[ (t_n > 0 chosen inside the n-th basic neighbourhood).

labels.label: rem:topological_suspension_fact_functor
questions: 'functor from the category of topological spaces to itself' read as CategoryTheory.Functor TopCat TopCat (GX.Susp.functor), with the paper's topology.

labels.label: prop:susp_portly

hypotheses.note: not used (it only makes susp(Σ) Hausdorff, GX.Susp.instT2Space)
PreconnectedSpace; necessary: GX.Susp.susp_portly_needs_connected (Σ = Bool, U = Σ)

findings: l.774: the proof's lower-semicontinuity step uses 'since Σ is first countable', which is not a hypothesis of prop:susp_portly (l.745). The statement is nevertheless true without it: the Lean proof (local connectedness criterion, GX.isPreconnected_of_local) needs at O only the ball {r < ε} ⊆ W, whose trace on susp(U)∖O is π(U × ]0,ε[), connected because U is (Σ connected, U portly). Neither first countability nor the function f nor lem:connected_union is needed for the paper's topology.
questions: susp(U) ∖ {O} for U ⊆ Σ read as range(susp(U ↪ Σ)) ∖ O (the functor applied to the inclusion), proved equal to π(U × ℝ₊*).

labels.label: lem:connected_union

hypotheses.paper: non-empty family of non-empty connected open subsets
hypotheses.note: [Nonempty ι], IsConnected (U i), IsOpen (U i); openness is used only for ⇒

findings: l.752: 'The ⋃ U_i is connected' — typo for 'Then'. The paper omits the proof; it is proved here from mathlib's IsPreconnected.transGen_of_iUnion and IsConnected.iUnion_of_reflTransGen.
questions: 'I/∼ is a singleton' read as Subsingleton (Quot ∼) (I nonempty), equivalently ∀ i j, EqvGen ∼ i j.

labels.label: rem:proof_above_works_quotient
findings: For the quotient topology the apex step is genuinely different (a quotient neighbourhood of O need not contain a ball): the Lean proof uses the tube neighbourhood π(⋃_σ B_σ × [0,δ_σ[) with B_σ connected open and chains the pieces π((B_σ ∩ U) × ]0,δ_σ[) by lem:connected_union-style reflexive-transitive chaining over the connected Σ — so lem:connected_union is where the quotient version needs it; still no first countability.

kb_proposals: A quotient Σ × ℝ≥0 / (Σ × {0}) with a generateFrom topology: prove the apex neighbourhood basis by induction on GenerateOpen (positive generators never contain the apex) and 𝓝 (mk p) = map mk (𝓝 p) off the apex; every topological property then splits into two cases.
Writing (univ : Set Bool) → Bool parses as a Π-binder named univ; write ↥(univ : Set Bool) → Bool.
At this pin zero_le has its argument implicit (zero_le : 0 ≤ a); use eq_zero_or_pos / nonpos_iff_eq_zero for ℝ≥0 case splits; ReflTransGen.symmetric is deprecated for the Std.Symm instance.
notes: Imports GXScaffold.Singular.Quotient (for GX.DInfty and the instance GX.locallyConnectedSpace_prod it defines) and Mathlib.Topology.Category.TopCat.Basic. Builds with no warnings (lake env lean and lake build GXScaffold.Singular.Suspension), 0 sorry; axioms of all headline results are propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. When Quotient.lean graduates, this file's DInfty import moves with it. Namespaces: GX.Susp (paper topology) and GX.SuspQ (quotient topology, a type synonym); GX.Susp.map is the suspension functor on maps (it shadows Filter.map only under `open GX.Susp`).
